attribution.title: De Dokwerker - reconstruction from photographs
attribution.author: Map Recall; sculpture by Mari Andriessen (1952); figure reconstructed from photographs by A.A.W.J. Rietman, Bert Verhoeff for Anefo, Joop van Bilsen for Anefo
attribution.modifications: Figure reconstructed (TRELLIS.2 multi-view) from Wikimedia Commons photographs: "Amsterdam, De dokwerker 07.JPG" by A.A.W.J. Rietman (CC BY-SA 4.0, https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Amsterdam,_De_dokwerker_07.JPG); "Herdenking februaristaking vlag halfstok bij dokwerken, Bestanddeelnr 925-4107.jpg" by Bert Verhoeff for Anefo (CC0, https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Herdenking_februaristaking_vlag_halfstok_bij_dokwerken,_Bestanddeelnr_925-4107.jpg); "Herdenking februaristaking 1941 op Jonas Daniel Meijerplein Na de kranslegging , Bestanddeelnr 916-0908.jpg" by Joop van Bilsen for Anefo (CC0, https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Herdenking_februaristaking_1941_op_Jonas_Daniel_Meijerplein_Na_de_kranslegging_,_Bestanddeelnr_916-0908.jpg). Decimated to about 6,000 triangles per figure in the kit's material, no photo colour; plinth, pier and setting are the original low-poly kit model. Provenance: scripts/sculptures/rebuild-sources/de-dokwerker.json.
